collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: Two villagers wonder whether distant people hurry home to spouses, friends, relatives, pets, or simply a peaceful room.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two villagers wonder whether distant people hurry home to spouses, friends, relatives, pets, or simply a peaceful room.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A grandmother imagines several generations arguing cheerfully over the same cooking fire.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A villager raised in a small household points out that crowded homes can be comforting or exhausting.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The group imagines a content craftsperson enjoying privacy after work.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Someone asks whether a solitary person might want company but have trouble finding it; nobody dismisses the possibility.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They decide that care and safety may matter more than a dwelling's size.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A builder says shelter and reliable water matter too; the conversation turns practical.
